module.summary: RTT-Inside drift-bounded structural report for ERCOT Austin Metro cluster — a cloud and enterprise hub with a strong tech ecosystem, anchored by Oracle, Meta, and Microsoft with emerging hyperscale expansion.

ai.module.description: Cluster-level module manifest for ERCOT Austin Metro. Covers 11 facilities including Oracle cloud campuses, Meta AI expansion nodes, Microsoft cloud compute, Switch edge facility, and regional enterprise. Includes RTT operator scores, drift/coherence envelopes, facility list, and navigation pointers.
